text:
casey_pm: Quick sync - need to recruit 3 design partners for a compact Private+Dedicated pilot. Focus: routing resilience, KMS integration, and rollback behavior. Target shortlist by Tue, invites out by Fri.

evan_se: I'll own the tech screens and the onboarding quickstart. ETA: demo + repo by Thu.

casey_pm: Incentive suggestion: $4k credits + 8 weeks Dedicated priority + weekly office hours. Also NDA + short MOU committing to 6-8 weeks active testing. Thoughts?

rita_ops: Ops note: confirm network option early (VPC peering vs VPN vs hosted edge). I can support peering for 2 partners; third may need VPN. I'll produce a 1-page infra checklist.

sam_research: Proposed product acceptance metrics: p50/p95 latency on canonical 10-prompt suite; fallback failure rate <1%; onboarding dev-effort <= 3 dev-days; automated eval pass rate >=90% for extraction prompts.

casey_pm: Screening Qs draft: 1) Typical QPS and avg token length? 2) KMS vendor + rotation policy? 3) Region / data residency needs? 4) Can you accept VPC peering or VPN? 5) Who signs off on rollout? Please add a sample prompt + expected output.

evan_se: Onboarding quickstart will include this curl to trigger routing/fallback logging: ```curl -X POST https://private.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DP_KEY' -d '{"model":"redwood-routing-1","prompt":"Test fallback","timeout_ms":1000}'```

rita_ops: Pre-Dedicated checklist (short): IP allowlist, VPN creds or peering setup, KMS test key, on-call contact. Also require security questionnaire for regulated partners.

sam_research: Eval plan: three families - convo, extraction, short code. I'll share a 10-prompt canonical set and an automated nightly job to run evals; partners can opt to run on their side or allow us to run against a canned dataset.

legal-bot: NDA "Design Partner" v2026-02-10 available at https://redwood.docs/nda-dp. Use this for all invites.

casey_pm: Owners: @evan_se onboarding + quickstart, @rita_ops infra + runbook, @sam_research metrics + prompts, @casey_pm outreach. Success rule to graduate: 2/3 partners meet p95 and fallback SLOs, integration <=3 dev-days, and no critical security blockers. Otherwise iterate.

evan_se: I'll drop repo link + 5min demo clip once ready.

rita_ops: I'll publish infra checklist and rollback playbook (auto-split to hosted if p95 breached for X minutes).

casey_pm: Outreach plan: short email + calendar invite, include NDA link, MOU, acceptance criteria, and incentives. Target: 3 warm leads + 4 cold prospects. Please update the shared sheet when you take ownership.

sam_research: Adding one final ask: require partners to provide one real-world prompt sample and expected output so we can baseline quality before enabling Dedicated.

casey_pm: Great. Keep it lightweight and fast. Shortlist by Tue EOD, invites Fri AM. Thanks everyone.
